_meta.source: Pakistani retailer listings and installer price guides (URLs, dates and quotes on every item); no official price list exists
_meta.method: Equipment only, no installation. With 1-3 publishers: lowest low and highest high; with 4+ publishers: median of each publisher's low and high. n_sources counts distinct publishers; an item with one publisher is low confidence.
_meta.notes:
Sources are retailer listings and installer price guides; no ProPakistani, Business Recorder, Dawn or Tribune price article for 2026 inverters/batteries was found. n_sources counts distinct publishers; low/high use each publisher's own min/max, and the median rule is applied only where 4+ publishers exist (on-grid 10 kW, hybrid 6 kW).
W11stop (w11stop.com) returns HTTP 403 to direct fetching, so its figures/dates come from search-engine snippets of the pages and are not verified on the live page; W11stop pages often show a second, different price in the spec table and different 'updated on' dates on duplicate URLs. Treat W11stop as weakest.
Powerhouse Express collection pages show no update date (only '2026' in title, images dated Jul 31 2026); many items there are 'Price on Request'.
Hybrid 4 kW rests on one publisher (W11stop, five products) - n_sources 1; Inverex/Growatt/Solis 4 kW prices not found. Knox Krypton 5600 4 kW elsewhere at Rs 117,000-156,000 but those pages were undated/2025 or discontinued; not counted.
Lithium per kWh: one source only (Solar Citizen). Aston Energy (astonenergy.com.pk) gives Rs 28,000-74,218 per kWh and 5.12 kWh Rs 195,000-320,000 but shows no page date, so excluded. Per-kWh not derived from pack prices (would be ~42,000-61,000 if divided by 5.12 kWh, but that is a derivation, not a quote).
Excluded outliers: W11stop Knox Krypton 11008 8 kW at Rs 1,950,000 (data error); pakistansolartraders Huawei 10 kW on-grid PKR 450,000-600,000 (undated, ~1.5-2x every dated listing); solar-price.pk tubular tables (updated July 17, 2026; Phoenix UGLT-255 200 Ah at Rs 28,500-30,500, about half every other source incl. Phoenix's own list); solarhubofficial.com 200 Ah tubular Rs 67,000-78,000 (dated Mar/Apr 2026, outside the preferred window); icons.com.pk Phoenix UGLT-255 200 Ah Rs 52,250 (April 8, 2026, outside window, consistent with included range).
Hybrid 6 kW includes a low Crown Xavier II at Rs 140,000 (solarpanelrates) - kept because the median absorbs it. On-grid 5 kW range is wide: Solis single-phase Rs 120,000 vs Huawei three-phase Rs 350,000.
No Deye price found for any size. No Sungrow 5 kW on-grid price found. Prices are equipment only unless stated; installation, Wi-Fi dongle, and meters excluded.
_meta.status: Secondary sources only; refresh monthly with data/solar-prices.json.
